page.overview:
What is Battle of the Corellian Shipyards?

The Battle of the Corellian Shipyards, also known as the battle on Corellia was a battle fought on the Core Worlds planet Corellia concurrent with the destruction of Starlight Beacon as part of the Nihil conflict in 230 BBY. Alys "Crash" Ongwa and members of her company fought alongside Jedi Masters Kantam Sy, Cohmac Vitus, and Yoda, Padawans Reath Silas and Ram Jomaram, and Zeen Mrala against Nihil forces led by Sabata Krill, who attempted to steal ships from Coronet City's shipyards.

The battle on Corellia first appeared in the 2022 young-adult novel The High Republic: Midnight Horizon, written by Daniel José Older and released as part of the Star Wars: The High Republic publishing initiative.
